headlines.title: Premarket movers: Airbnb, Cloudflare, IREN rally; Atlassian, Five9 tumble
headlines.summary: Investing.com - U.S. stock futures pointed to a mixed open on Friday as chip stocks rebounded following a broad-based selloff in the previous session, offering some relief to investors worried about the impact of the Democratic midterm election victory on the artificial intelligence boom.

headlines.title: Airbnb Shares Jump Over 10% as Third-Quarter Earnings Beat Forecasts and Travel Bookings Accelerate
headlines.summary: Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter financial results, supported by accelerating travel demand, higher booking volumes and improved pricing. The accommodation platform delivered its fastest revenue growth in more than three years and raised its full-year outlook, sending its shares more than 10% higher in premarket trading on Friday.

headlines.title: Airbnb Is Growing Again—and Even It’s Surprised
headlines.summary: The vacation rental site reports double-digit increases in nights and seats booked and in gross booking value for the third quarter.

headlines.summary: Airbnb Inc (ABNB) posted 19% revenue growth to $4.9 billion, raised its full-year outlook, and unveiled a new $12 billion share repurchase program alongside ambitious AI and hotel expansion plans.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
